name: Turtle System 2: daily 55-day breakout
source: The Turtle traders' System 2 (Richard Dennis and William Eckhardt, 1983), as published in 'The Original Turtle Trading Rules' (Faith et al., 2003) and Curtis Faith, 'Way of the Turtle' (2007). Trend-following is the strategy family with the longest published record across many markets (Hurst, Ooi and Pedersen, 'A Century of Evidence on Trend-Following Investing', AQR, 2017).
notes: Written 30 Oct 2026 before any run. Choices where this differs from the original: the breakout is a daily CLOSE beyond the 55-day high/low of the earlier days (the Turtles used a stop order one tick beyond it intraday), because rules here run on finished candles; N is MT5's ATR(20) (the Turtles' N was a 20-day exponential average of the true range); one position per market, no adding units (the Turtles added up to 4 units every N/2); size from v1's risk per trade on the 2N stop. Stop 2N; exit at the 20-day low (buys) or high (sells), the System 2 exit. No target. Held overnight; swaps are charged.
